sources.title: Qwen3-VL 4B Abliterated (ComfyUI / Krea 2 Text Encoder) BF16 / FP8
sources.snippet: This is a vision-language version of Qwen3-VL 4B that has been abliterated and converted into a single ComfyUI-compatible safetensors file. It can be used as a Krea 2 text encoder inside ComfyUI while preserving the model's vision capabilities, making it suitable for workflows that use image-aware prompt enhancement.
